about.bio:
I'm a writer and Ph.D. candidate in the English department at Boston College, where I studies Weird fiction, modernism, and philosophical aesthetics. My dissertation compares modernism and Weird fiction's responses to various crises in the late 19th and early 20th century.

My writing's appeared in academic journals and magazines. When not reading, writing, teaching, or researching, I can be found making music, watching movies, walking around cities, and trying to understand the eternal mysteries. I'm always happy to talk with students, journalists, critics, and fellow readers, and can be reached at the email below.
